title: sync-game-sources
responsibility: Owns the sync-game-sources build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: embeddedSource.destination
inputs.description: The generated src/lib/game destination path used to select the corresponding engine source before import rewriting. It should be a key in gameSourceLayout; the function does not explicitly validate unknown destinations.

inputs.name: embeddedSource.text
inputs.description: The engine TypeScript source text passed for embedding and Prettier formatting. Relative imports are rewritten only when their resolved .ts target is represented in gameSourceLayout; otherwise the function throws Error.

outputs.name: gameSourceLayout
outputs.description: Readonly mapping from generated game source destination paths to engine source paths. It contains the 13 pairs used by the script to embed files into src/templates/game-authoring/gameSources.ts.

outputs.name: embeddedSource
outputs.description: A Promise resolving to formatted TypeScript text with mapped relative imports rewritten for the generated destination. It rejects with Error when a relative import resolves to a .ts source path that is not represented in gameSourceLayout.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when a relative module specifier resolves to a .ts path that is not represented in gameSourceLayout. In that case embeddedSource rejects instead of returning formatted source.
